title: cooked sweeper
pitch: minesweeper.exe has a virus. the numbers are virus power, every virus is a fight, and KERNEL PANIC is waiting.
controls: tap / click a tile to reveal it. right-click, long-press or the ⚑ flag button flags a guessed power. arrows + space or enter on a keyboard, f or 1-9 flag, l levels up, n new run, d today's disk, m mutes.
how_to: numbers show the TOTAL power of the viruses touching that tile.
revealing a virus is a fight: lose hp equal to its power, gain that much xp (popups are free: 0 hp). 0 hp = bluescreen.
level up (full heal, +1 max hp) whenever you have the xp. beaten viruses drop ram (heal) and scans.
beat KERNEL PANIC (13) to win. today's infected disk is the same board for everyone.
